tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal mgon stag zhon 'khor bcas kyi bskang gso'i cho ga lag len rab gsal 'phrin las myur 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so// swa sti/ bla ma dang dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal nag po chen po stag zhon 'khor bcas kyi thugs dam bskang ba'i cho ga byed par 'dod pas rten bshams nas 'di'i dam rdzas gtor ma'i bar paṇḍi ta chen po nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i gtor chog ltar dang / bskang gtor gru gsum che ba/ de'i mdun du gru gsum chung ba gsum/ de rnams kyi mthar mtheb kyu ji ltar rigs pas bskor ba smug rtsi sogs kyis byugs pa/ gtor gdugs sam/ ba dan sogs dang mar gyi phyag mtshan me ri sogs ci mdzes dang / kha zas bzang dgu ci 'byor gyis bskor/ kha rlangs sogs ma phog pa gal che/ gtor rtsam yang na rjen 'thag phye la bdud rtsi ril bu'i phye ma dang sman sna gang 'dzoms btab/ phud ma nyams pa dang gtsang sbra gal che/ bsad sha ma yin pa kha na ma tho ba med pa'i sha rnyed na dmar rgyan bya/ bsad sha dang / rang gi nor phyugs shi ba'i sha khrag mi 'bul/ god kha 'gram nyen yong gsungs/ spro na dbang po lnga'i me tog lcags kyu lnga sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i mchod pa dang / de ma grub na chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod sogs dang / rin po che dang / stag gzigs lpags pa sogs dang / rgyan drug ja bu ram/ ka ra go mtshon sogs spyan gzigs ci tsam 'byor pa bkod pa legs shing yid 'khul nus pa bshams/ rnal 'byor pa rnal 'byor bla med kyi dbang dang mgon po 'di'i rjes gnang sogs thob cing dam tshig gtsang la yi dam chos skyong gi bsnyen song sogs mtshan nyid ldan pas/ skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar gtor chog bzhin bya/ 'on kyang gur zhal sogs kyi bskang gso dang 'brel tshe/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi gong du 'di'i gtor bsngo byed/ phyogs skyong las gshin sogs byed pa yin na/

de dag gi yang gong du byed dgos so/ /gang ltar bzlas bshags sogs grub nas sam/ gur zhal sogs kyi bskang gso byed na de dag gi rjes sam/ skabs su gang bab dang bstun no/ /bskang rdzas byin rlabs las 'jam po'i phyogs la gur gyi bskang ba he ru ka dpal ma'i 'og na yod pa'i sngags drug phyag drug sogs bya/ yang na 'di bzhin bya ste/ bskang rdzas rnams la dmigs nas rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor zhing / oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ ces pas bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs stong ba'i ngang las gnas khang drag po'i gzhal yas khang mi mgo skam po'i rtsigs pa dang rgyu ma'i drwa phyed 'phyang ba/ bse smug po'i sgo can/ steng du zhing chen gyi bla bre dang / mi ro'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du a las byung ba'i thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che bar/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dgra bgegs bkug nas bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus gsum gyi gtor ma ri dang rgya mtshor mnyam pa/ khrag gi mchod yon/ dbang po lnga'i me tog tshil gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/ rkang gling thod rnga sogs rol mo'i bye brag gzhan yang hūm̐ mthing nag re re las byung ba'i bya nag rta nag g.yag nag lug nag khyi nag mi nag rnams dbang po rdzogs shing rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag gzigs go khrab gos dar la sogs pa phyi nang gi dam rdzas dngos su 'byor pa dang yid kyi sprul pa dpal rdo rje nag po che legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa la sogs pa dam can rgya mtsho mnyes par byed pa'i mchod pa'i sprin phung nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā warta ya ā warta ya ho/ badzra spha ra ṇā khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pas byin gyi rlabs/ rnga sil sogs rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/

hūm̐ phyag na rdo rje gtum po ni/ /rab khros ma hā kā la che/ /mgon po stag zhon 'khor bcas rnams/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su sol/ /snyigs ma lnga bdor sgrub dus su/ /gsungs pa'i dam tshig 'di dgongs la/ /mgon po༞ /gnas༞ /sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan snga ru/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /mgon po༞ gnas༞ /li yul lcang rar u rgyan gyis/ /spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas shing / /mgon po༞ gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra a kakṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pa'i spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥsngar bzhugs rnams la bstim/ mtshan nyid ldan pa'i gzhal yas dam pa 'dir/ /dam tshig can gyi rnal 'byor bdag cag rnams/ /dam rdzas mchod gtor 'dod yon sna tshogs kyis/ /thugs dam bskang phyir brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /ro bcud brgya ldan gser skyems gtsang ma dang / /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i rakta'i mchod yon 'di/ /dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /byon skyems dam par 'bul gyis dges par rol/ /oṃ shrī ma hā ka la sa pa ri wā ra badzra a sa na tiṣṭhantu sa ma ya staṃ/ pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rakta arghaṃ pra ti tstsha swā hā/ de nas rol mo bzhag te/ gtor chog ltar sngags lan gsum la sogs pa'i bskang gtor phul/ bskang ba dngos ni dbyangs rol mo dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ hūm̐ bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyi nang gis/ /mchod gtor mthun pa'i dam rdzas legs 'bul gyis/ /thugs dam dgongs la brtse zhing rab dges pas/ /zag med bde ba bskyed phyir bzhes su gsol/ /mtshan ldan thod pa dkar po yangs pa'i nang / /dam nyams bsgral ba'i sha rus don snying lnga/ /'bru sna sgron me lcags kyu ye shes lnga/ /byin rlabs bzhed dgu'i gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /khrag gis mchod yon dbang lnga'i me tog dang / /tshil chen bdug spos zhun chen sgron me sbar/ /khrag zhag mkhris chab dmar nag bshos bu dang /

/rkang gling thod rnga la sogs rol mo'i tshogs/ /snyan brjid 'gying pa'i dbyangs kyi nga ro sogs/ /stag zhon 'khor bcas dges pa'i bzhes su gsol/ /me dpung rdo rje'i gur khang yangs pa'i nang / /'jigs rung dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus/ /mi mgo'i brtsigs pa lcang lo'i kha bad can/ /rgyu ma'i drwa phyed zhing lpags bla bre bres/ /mi ro'i rgyal mtshan glo snying 'phan tshar byas/ /keng rus thog phub bse'i sgo glegs la/ /gnam lcags gzer btab khro chu'i rwa bas bskor/ /me rlung 'khrug pa drag po'i gnas khang 'di/ /legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /rta nag g.yag nag lug nag khyi nag dang / /mi nag mchu sder rab 'jigs bya yi tshogs/ /dre'u dmar nag bong bu gwa dmar dang / /seng ge glang chen gcan gzan 'jigs pa'i tshogs/ /yid bzhin nor bu bum bzang dpag bsam shing / /'dod 'jo'i ba dang rgyal srid rin chen bdun/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad 'dod yon rnam pa lnga/ /rin chen tshogs dang dar gos ja sogs dang / /dri bzang sman sna 'bru sna dpag med dang / /go cha mtshon cha gcan gzan lpags pa'i tshogs/ /rin chen rus pa mi mgo sbrul rgyan sogs/ /thun mong mchod rdzas nam mkha'i khams gang ba/ /legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /khyad par rten rdzas beng dang lcags par sogs/ /gsang rdzas bsnyen sgrub las 'byor dam rdzas sogs/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin dpag med rnams/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bar bzhes su gsol/ /de ltar rmad byung dam rdzas phyi nang gis/ /legs ldan stag zhon lcam dral thugs dam bskang / /sku gsung thugs kyi mgon po'i thugs dam bskang / /las kyi mgon po bdun gyi thugs dam bskang / /sde brgyad mgon po gtso 'khor thugs dam bskang / /gnod sbyin brgyad dang gshin rje brgyad la sogs/ /dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud thugs dam bskang /

/thugs dam skong zhing nyams chags sos gyur cig /bshags pa ni/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dgongs/ /bdag cag las dang nyon mongs dbang gyur pa'i/ /spyi dang khyad par dam tshig nyams pa sogs/ /bsam sbyor nongs pa gang mchis mthol lo bshags/ /ma dag tha mal 'dzin pa'i sgrib gyur te/ /rim gnyis ma sgrub bsnyen sgrub g.yel sogs dang / /mchod gtor chags dang mi gtsang phud nyams sogs/ /gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags/ /dmigs med thugs rjes klong du bzod par gsol/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dag par byin gyi rlobs/ /'phrin 'chol ni/ khyed la 'phrin las gnyer du gsol ba ni/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' bsgos dam bzhag ltar/ /rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par ring lugs 'di/ /srid mtha' bar du mi nyams rgyas par mdzod/ /'jig rten khams kun bde zhing lo phyugs legs/ /chos srid dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag khyed la ltos bcas rnams/ /lus dang grib ma ltar 'grogs sdong grogs mdzod/ /nad gdon rims dang dgra bgegs gnod pa sogs/ /mi mthun bar chad nye bar 'tshe ba rnams/ /myur du zhi zhing med par mdzad du gsol/ /mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams ye shes dang / /dpal 'byor 'khor dang longs spyod dbang phyug sogs/ /legs pa'i yon tan mtha' dag dbyar mtsho ltar/ /gang zhing rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ /gnas 'dis zas nor longs spyod 'khor sogs la/ /dgra rkun 'jab bus khyer la ltas ngan thong / /zhi bas mi 'dul gdug can dbyings su sgrol/ /nyes pa kun bral legs pa'i gzhi thing la/ /bsam don kun 'grub bstan pa 'dzin par mdzod/ /mdor na zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las rnams/ /gang bcol thogs pa med pa 'grub pa dang / /sa lam bgrod nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa/ /myur du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las rgya chen mdzod/ /bzlog pa ni/ hūm̐ lha chen dpal 'bar mthu ma chung /

/sogs brjod/ bstod pa la rnga brdung ba spro na/ gong gtor bsngo'i skabs su mi byed par 'dir bya'o/ /bstod pa'i tshig ni/ hūm̐ brjod med spros bral sogs gtor chog ltar ro/ /thun gtor ram/ 'gyogs gtor 'bul bar spro na/ gong bsham gyi skabs su/ lcags sder la sogs par gtor chung gru gsum dmar po bzhi bshams pa/ skabs 'dir legs ldan stag zhon 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ 'dir gshegs rgyan gyis gtor ma sogs kyi khang steng la sogs pa gtsang sar 'bul/ dmigs pa ni mgon po'i sprul pa pho nya las mkhan rnams kyi gtor ma bzhes shing dgra bgegs tshar bcad par bsam la/ rol mo'am dril bsil bcas sngags shib bur bzla'o/ /thun gtor ma byung skyon cher med/ de ltar gtor bzhi gcig la yun ring du mchod gtor 'bul na snga ma rnams la gtor ma dngos gzhi de bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyi rlabs nas phud nas cung zad 'bul zhing yongs rdzogs 'bul ba'i dmigs pa mi byed/ nub re bzhin mtheb kyus kha gsos pa rnams 'bul ba yin la/ mtheb kyu yang lnga tshar sogs kyi gral gyi dam rdzas gtor ma dang / bskang gtor gnyis char la mtheb kyu bzhi re gso ba byung na legs/ dmigs bsal ni gtor ma dngos gzhi la che chung bzhi re yod pa/ mgon po lcam dral nang gi las mkhan/ phyi'i 'khor tshogs spyi rnams re re yin par snang bas so/ /mtheb kyu rnams kyang ma rul ma 'bags la ma lhung ba dgos so/ /gtor gzhi spod pa'i mchod gtor grol ba'i tshe gtor ma rnams yongs rdzogs phul ba'i dmigs pa byed spro na/ yi dam gyi gtor ma ma gtogs khang steng sogs su spyi btab kyis dbul lo/ /mtshan mo yin na grib gnon gyi gdon bsrung phyir dpal 'bar dgos par bshad/ nyin mo mi dgos so/ /rjes kyi bya ba rnams gtor chog ltar bya'o/ /de ltar dpal rdo rje nag po chen po legs ldan stag zhon 'khor bcas kyi thugs dam bskang ba'i cho ga lag len rab gsal 'phrin las myur 'grub ces bya ba 'di ni don du gnyer ba'i bskul ngor 'di'i yi ge rnying pa mang du mthong yang /

tshig gi cha bde ba dang byin rlabs che khyad nas sa lo 'jam dbyangs chen po'i bskang gsar la gtso bor brten zhing gzhan nas kyang legs bshad kyis cha cung zad blangs nas shākya'i dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'o/ /'dis mtshon dge tshogs ma lus sdom pa'i mthus/ /ji srid byang chub snying po ma thob bar/ /lus rten bla ma chos sogs mthun rkyen kun/ /bka' srung rnams kyis 'bad med sgrub par shog /paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i gtor chog gi lhan thabs yin no// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ dpal mgon stag zhon 'khor bcas kyi bskang gso'i cho ga PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
